A security release. Every binary built from 0.6.0 and earlier trusted the compromised emSign intermediate certificates, whose private keys can be recovered by anyone, so a machine on the network path could present a forged certificate for the vendor's market-data host and, on Linux, its login host. Update the Python wheel, the TypeScript package, the C ABI library, the local server and the MCP server.

## Security

- **TLS distrusts the compromised emSign intermediates.** The shipped builds move to webpki-roots 1.0.10, rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and rustls 0.23.46 (RUSTSEC-2026-0381, RUSTSEC-2026-0382, and RUSTSEC-2026-0346 to RUSTSEC-2026-0349). On macOS and Windows the login connection is verified by the operating system, so it is protected by the operating system's own update. The streaming and flat-file connections pin the vendor's key and were not exposed.
- **Rust.** The crate now requires rustls 0.23.46, rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and webpki-roots 1.0.10, so a project that depends on it picks the fixed versions up on its next `cargo update`.

There are no API changes. The dependency updates that came with this release are patch and minor releases.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/userFRM/ThetaDataDx/blob/v0.6.1/CHANGELOG.md) for the details.
